description: Propose a RECURRING payment (e.g. $50 monthly to a Moneda user or a contact's Base wallet). Creates a draft the user reviews, approves and signs with their passkey in the Moneda mobile app; nothing is sent until then and you never schedule or move funds yourself. Not for one-off payments: use initiate_payment. Look up the recipient first (search_users, get_contacts). The draft expires after 48 hours if the user does not approve it.

amount.description: Amount per payment in user-facing units (e.g. '50.00')

contactAccountId.description: The contact wallet's account ID (from get_contacts), when the contact has several wallets

contactUsername.description: Contact username or display name for transfer_contact_wallet

endDate.description: Last possible payment date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no end.

paymentType.description: transfer_moneda (to a Moneda user, pass recipientUsername) or transfer_contact_wallet (to a contact's wallet on Base, pass contactUsername or contactAccountId)

reference.description: Optional memo attached to each payment

startDate.description: First payment date, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's timezone. Today or later, within a year.

name: propose_scheduled_payment
